decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter builds directly on the firm's curing, seasoning and organic know-how and is its strategic flagship, so management can read its early results and refine it within existing competencies.

Poultry mini salami snacks extend the firm's established salami expertise into the organic growth direction, so the knowledge base supports learning and adjustment even though the snack format carries somewhat more market risk.
The premium sharing salami line closely uses the firm's maturation and recipe capabilities, letting it assimilate market feedback and adapt the variants rather than withdraw the line.
